reason: The README clearly describes a DSH chat plugin whose primary purpose is generating images through APIs or local CLIs and analyzing images into structured evidence.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 聊天窗口中通过兼容 API 或本机 CLI 生成并展示图片，并使用可用的视觉 CLI 识别本地或网络图片。
summaries.en: Generates and displays images in the DSH chat window through compatible APIs or local CLIs, and analyzes local or remote images with available vision CLI tools.

capabilities: generates images through configured OpenAI-compatible APIs or detected local CLI tools
analyzes local image files or HTTP(S) image URLs using detected CLI vision capabilities
displays generated images in the DSH chat interface
registers and uses an image-generation skill when supported CLI tools are detected
